summary.intent: Drive Caliper to a v1 alpha by running the planned Entire trails (comparison/oracle, perf, detection, release flow) with parallel worker agents, then getting PR #490 (list props by usage / main-props rule) and the follow-up memory, oracle and release work reviewed, fixed and ready to merge.
summary.outcome: Created trails 153-158, delivered draft PRs (#280-#283 etc.), diagnosed a failed release as a Callisto E148 race, and pushed weekly-oracle and converter-memo (Chakra -324 MiB) branches linked to trail 405. The #490 rule fixes are only partly done and unpushed, so its Entire findings are still open, and the worker for it is mid-run.

repo: Entire opens PRs automatically when a branch is pushed and linked with `entire trail link N --branch B --base BASE`; PR titles and bodies must be edited afterwards while keeping the Entire marker. Stacked branches need `--base <parent>` set at link time.
Entire findings only see pushed commits, so local fixes leave findings open until pushed. Resolve them in Entire with the commit and test afterwards.

Callisto is at 0.16.0 (latest). GitHub Releases need `publish-to=["github-release"]` plus a `[release]` section with a Cargo product package. Attested artifacts are verified against a signer workflow named `callisto-release.yml`, which would force a rename of `release.yml`; this is unconfirmed in source.
The Callisto E148 failure (release PR snapshot changed) is a race between consecutive pushes. It is harmless: re-running the job or the next push fixes it.

Weekly measurement and oracle tooling live in `scripts/weekly.py`, `scripts/rdt.mjs`, `scripts/rdg.mjs` and `apps/oracle`. The oracle runs with `node src/oracle.ts` because `tsx` fails on its IPC socket under the sandbox.
Chakra memory is dominated by the converter memo (about 480 MiB of 3.6M nodes with only about 7.5k distinct), which is why interning cuts about 324 MiB.
The sandbox blocks the npm registry, `git fetch` and write locks under `~/.local/share/entire`. Workers' `just lint` failures from that are false negatives, so rerun lint outside the sandbox.
About 60 worktrees accumulate under `.claude/worktrees/`, many locked and from merged PRs. A peer session, `cleanup-merged-branches-worktrees`, handles cleanup.

code.finding: The `Vec::contains` scan over layer members is quadratic for large collapsed layers, about 6.8M comparisons for a 3,700-member layer. The fix indexes layer membership once and skips sources `add` discards.

With `collapseInheritedProps: 'none'`, props typed as `ReturnType<typeof makeProps>` request an empty React set, so the checker drops every React property. Fixed in the session lane only; the CLI merge path still has it.

workflow: Hold pushes until a worker's whole pass is green to avoid the user's push/fix/push loop, but the user wants findings cleared promptly, so offer a partial push explicitly.
Use isolated-worktree workers that commit locally and don't push. The coordinator verifies signatures and gates, pushes, links to the trail, then publishes the PR body.
Worker `SendMessage` resume works after transient API errors such as ENOTFOUND. Have the resumed worker inspect the worktree first and finish or revert half-applied edits.
Subagent reports are not user authority. Re-run gates they couldn't run, such as lint under the sandbox, and report what was and wasn't verified.

friction: Brain `brief` failed on a sandbox write-lock denial and was never retried outside the sandbox.
Worker output was truncated in the middle of the Callisto gap report, which needed a resend.
Repeated duplicate task-notifications from the same acceptance worker added noise.
An API ENOTFOUND error killed two workers mid-task, losing in-flight edits and requiring a resume.
The remote head of `perf/converter-memo-interning` (1335c3d2) differed from the worker's reported 06f6eccf and was not investigated.
The sandbox blocked `git fetch` and the npm registry for workers, and machine load of 9-27 made timings unreliable.
The user was frustrated by long push/fix loops and slow handling of findings on #490.
open_items: #490 (`feat/list-props-by-usage`): finish the CLI-merge half of the react_types.rs:452 finding, 10 review findings, Step 2 rule changes (aliases, reads into large layers, mapped copies, hook hand-offs), change 8 (body-less MUI `.d.ts` components mean unknown), the Chakra fixture still at about 865 rows, the differential, ADR 0028 and changeset, and a final `/code-review`. Then push, run the acceptance command on the final build, and resolve the Entire findings.
Decide whether the new weekly coverage floor (50%) stays; it would flag Chakra and Mantine every week until the cause of 'not judged' is found.

Trail 158 release flow: the user must decide on the `release.yml` to `callisto-release.yml` rename, an optional E148 retry, and Homebrew tap behavior (tags vs latest release), and the release flow must be rehearsed on a scratch repo.

Trail 153: `oracle/three-tools-report` waits on #280-#283 merging. The key-collision branch was skipped, antd recall is 92.1% against a ~95% target, and Mantine, Chakra and Spectrum need a CI weekly run to validate the new rules.
Trails 155/156 (detection stack) and 157 not yet started. Trail 154 perf reached only about -6% time and -5% RSS, short of its baseline.
MUI `OverridableComponent` components (Button, Select) aren't extracted by either binary; this is a separate gap, possibly its own slice.
Chakra memory is still above 1 GiB (about 1.1-1.2 GiB expected with #491 plus interning). Allocator slack and the rest of the converter are further options.
Open PR bodies for the weekly-oracle and converter-memo branches once Entire opens the PRs; the user must approve all merges and releases.
Worktree cleanup: message the `cleanup-merged-branches-worktrees` session with a keep-list (the user's choice), and do not remove the live `agent-ace6850…` worktree.
Spectrum's 1.09% oracle wrong-rate is uninvestigated, and the release 0.11.0 recovery (E167) needs a user choice.
